scenarios.name: timer1_free_run_unmasked
scenarios.description: Timer1 free-running mode with unmasked interrupt. Load count = 0x100, mode=0 (free-run), intmask=0, ena=1. Poll TIMER1INTST until bit[0]=1 (interrupt fires). Read TIMER1EOI to clear. Verify TIMER1CV after EOI.
steps: 2. Wait >= 1 APB cycle for write to latch
6. Read TIMER1CV(0x04) — verify counter is near MAX (free-run reload)
scenarios.expected_result: TIMER1INTST[0] transitions from 0→1. TIMER1EOI read returns 1 (acknowledged). No UVM_ERROR from checker.
scenarios.review_note: Pulse-extended interrupt (TIMER1_PULSE_EXTD=1) widens atzero by 1 cycle; verify checker models this correctly.

scenarios.name: timer1_user_mode_masked
scenarios.description: Timer1 user-defined mode with interrupt masked. Load=0x40, mode=1, intmask=1. Poll INTST with short timeout (5000 polls) — expect timeout (INTST stays 0). Verifies mask correctly suppresses interrupt.
scenarios.expected_result: Poll returns 0 (timeout). Checker verifies INTST read always returns 0 when mask=1.
scenarios.review_note: 5000 polls may be insufficient at very slow AHB clock. Adjust max_polls if test runs on slow sim.

scenarios.name: timer1_user_mode_unmasked
scenarios.description: Timer1 user-mode unmasked after disable-reload sequence. Disable timer → wait → reload with load=0x20, enable in user-mode unmasked → poll until interrupt fires.
scenarios.expected_result: TIMER1INTST[0] reaches 1. Checker verifies count-down-to-zero interrupt in user-mode.
scenarios.review_note: Sequence explicitly disables then reloads to verify load_count is latched only on CR write, not transparent.

scenarios.name: timer2_free_run_unmasked
scenarios.description: Timer2 free-running mode, independent of timer1. Load=0x80, mode=0, intmask=0, ena=1.
scenarios.expected_result: TIMER2INTST[0] reaches 1. EOI clears it. No impact on timer1 state.
scenarios.review_note: Timer2 starts after timer1 scenarios — verifies timers operate independently.

scenarios.name: combined_registers_readback
scenarios.description: Read combined interrupt status registers after both timers have been exercised. Verify TIMERSINTST(0xA0), TIMERSEOI(0xA4), TIMERSRAW(0xA8) values.
preconditions: Timer1 and timer2 have been started and at least one interrupt has fired
steps: 1. Read TIMERSINTST(0xA0) — should reflect pending/acked state of both timers
2. Read TIMERSEOI(0xA4) — clears both timer interrupts
3. Read TIMERSRAW(0xA8) — should reflect raw interrupt before masking
scenarios.expected_result: Register read values match expected combined state. No checker mismatches.

scenarios.name: default_value_after_reset
scenarios.description: After reset, read all readable registers and verify they match reset values. CR=0, INTST=0, LC=0, CV=0xFFFFFFFF (timer disabled → CV from {WIDTH{1'b1}}).
scenarios.review_note: RTL: timer defaults to {WIDTH{1'b1}} when disabled. CV output only driven when timer_en=1.

scenarios.name: load_count_write_readback
scenarios.description: Write known values to TIMER1LC/TIMER2LC, then read back via TIMERSINTST or re-read after EOI to verify load value latches correctly.
steps: 3. Read back via internal reference — should be 0xCAFE_BABE
4. Enable timer, wait for interrupt, verify timer reloaded from last write value
scenarios.expected_result: Timer counts down from 0xCAFE_BABE and interrupts at the right count.
scenarios.review_note: LC is W-only in RTL but has internal register. Verify no read path leakage.

scenarios.name: control_register_all_bit_combinations
scenarios.description: Write each combination of {hwen, intmask, mode, ena} to TIMER1CR and TIMER2CR, verify readback. 16 combinations per timer.
steps: 1. For i in 0..15: Write TIMER1CR = i (4 lower bits)
4. Note: bit[3] is reserved, should read 0
scenarios.expected_result: CR readback matches last write (excluding reserved bit).
scenarios.review_note: Timer must be disabled (ena=0) before changing mode to avoid glitches.

scenarios.name: eoi_self_clear
scenarios.description: Read TIMER1EOI, verify interrupt clears, then read EOI again to verify it returns 0 (not sticky).
preconditions: Timer1 interrupt has fired and is latched
scenarios.expected_result: EOI first read = 1, then 0. INTST cleared after first EOI read.
scenarios.review_note: RTL: timer1eoi_ren used to clear timer_int_tmp via timereoi path.

scenarios.name: timers_eoi_combined_clear
scenarios.description: Read TIMERSEOI(0xA4) — clears both timer interrupts simultaneously.
preconditions: Both timer1 and timer2 interrupts are latched
scenarios.expected_result: Both INTST bits clear after single TIMERSEOI read.
scenarios.review_note: RTL: timerseoi_ren clears timer_int_tmp[i] for both i=0,1.

scenarios.name: load_count_equals_1
scenarios.description: Timer with load_count=1 triggers after 1 clock cycle of counting (fastest possible). Verifies atzero timing boundary.
steps: 4. Expect interrupt fires very quickly (1 count cycle)
scenarios.expected_result: Interrupt fires within a few poll iterations.
scenarios.review_note: Free-run reload to MAX after reaching 0; user-mode reloads from load_count=1 repeatedly.

scenarios.name: load_count_max_0xFFFFFFFF
scenarios.description: Load count = 0xFFFFFFFF (maximum). In free-run mode (mode=0), timer starts from load_value, counts to 0, reloads to MAX — effectively identical behavior. In user-mode, reloads from 0xFFFFFFFF.
steps: 3. Poll — expect very long delay or overflow
4. Verify TIMER1CV shows decrementing values on read
scenarios.expected_result: CV decreases monotonically. Interrupt fires after 0xFFFFFFFF+1 cycles (or never in practice for P0 — this is a P1 long-running test).
scenarios.review_note: Long-running test truncated to 200ns wait; checks CV decrement and CR readback bits rather than full MAX+1 cycle wait.

scenarios.name: load_count_zero
scenarios.description: Timer with load_count=0 in user-mode: counts from 0 → atzero fires immediately on next cycle.
scenarios.expected_result: Timer fires almost immediately; atzero fires on first clock edge after enable.
scenarios.review_note: RTL: load_value is latched, timer==0 check fires before decrement; verify no infinite loop.

scenarios.name: mask_toggle_at_runtime
scenarios.description: Start timer unmasked, wait for interrupt to fire and latch, then write intmask=1, verify INTST clears, then write intmask=0, verify pending interrupt is visible again.
scenarios.expected_result: INTST toggles with mask setting; raw TIMERSRAW remains 1 throughout.
scenarios.review_note: RTL: intmask gates ri_timer_int → ri_timer1intstatus, does not clear timer_int_tmp. Known limitation: checker predict_read does not gate INTST by mask, may flag spurious mismatches.

scenarios.name: disable_clears_latch
scenarios.description: While timer1 interrupt is pending (INTST==1), write CR ena=0 → verify timer_int_tmp clears immediately (INTST becomes 0).
steps: 4. Read TIMERSRAW → verify raw interrupt state
scenarios.expected_result: INTST clears on disable. RAW may remain depending on timer_frc internal state.
scenarios.review_note: RTL: timeren[i]==0 path clears timer_int_tmp[i]. Re-enable restarts counting from full reload.

scenarios.name: dual_timer_independent_operation
scenarios.description: Both timers started with different load values simultaneously; verify each timer fires interrupts independently and EOI clears only its own interrupt.
steps: 4. Read TIMER1EOI → verify TIMER1INTST clears but TIMER2INTST stays
5. Read TIMER2EOI → verify both INTST are 0
scenarios.expected_result: Timers operate independently; EOI is per-timer. TIMERSEOI clears both.
scenarios.review_note: Uses user-mode (mode=1) with different load values to verify dual-timer independence and shared TIMERSINTST/TIMERSEOI registers.

scenarios.name: frequent_readback_during_countdown
scenarios.description: While both timers are counting down, continuously read TIMER1CV and TIMER2CV via AHB; verify monotonic decrement on each read.
steps: 1. Enable both timers with small load values
2. In a loop, read CV of both timers
3. Compare successive reads — each should be <= previous read
4. Verify no read returns 0 while timer is still counting
scenarios.expected_result: CV values monotonically decrease for each timer independently.
scenarios.review_note: P2 priority — useful for toggling coverage of 32-bit CV register.

scenarios.name: undefined_address_read_returns_zero
scenarios.description: Read from undefined APB offsets (0x28, 0x30, 0x3C) within tim0 address space. RTL default case returns prdata=0.
scenarios.review_note: RTL: default case in prdata mux assigns 0.

scenarios.name: consecutive_write_overwrite
scenarios.description: Write LC/CR with value A, then immediately write value B. Verify only value B takes effect.
steps: 3. Enable timer, verify countdown starts from 0x5555_6666
scenarios.expected_result: Timer loads from most recent LC write (0x5555_6666).
scenarios.review_note: Simple sanity check for register write path.
